content.short: Uniswap is an Ethereum-based decentralized exchange enabling token swaps via liquidity pools.
content.description: Uniswap is one of the first and largest Ethereum-based decentralized exchanges. It popularized the automated market maker design that now underpins many DEXs. Instead of traditional order books, liquidity is supplied through a system of pre-funded and user-funded liquidity pools, enabling swaps to be executed algorithmically. Launched in 2018 by Hayden Adams, Uniswap's ecosystem has since broadened to include stablecoins, governance mechanisms, and analytics platforms.
